text: A binary relation ≺ on a set A is well-founded exactly when:
choices: every non-empty subset of A has a ≺-minimal element (equivalently, there is no infinite descending chain)
every element of A has a ≺-successor
explanation: Well-foundedness means every non-empty subset has a ≺-minimal element, equivalently that no infinite descending chain a₀ ≻ a₁ ≻ ⋯ exists. Finiteness is sufficient but not necessary (ℕ under < is infinite yet well-founded); option C describes an equivalence relation; and having successors is unrelated.
